classification.difficultyReason: Angle sum, then the same side found by cos with the given angle and by sin with the complementary angle. This is the same structure as p24-q7.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Calculate $x$ using the cosine ratio. Round your answer to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked:
$x$ is adjacent to $28^\circ$ and the hypotenuse is $9$.
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{A}{H}\\\cos28^\circ&=\frac{x}{9}\\9\cos28^\circ&=x\\x&\approx7.95\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Calculate $x$ using the sine ratio. Round your answer to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked:
$x$ is opposite $\angle Q=62^\circ$ and the hypotenuse is $9$.
$$\begin{align*}\sin\theta&=\frac{O}{H}\\\sin62^\circ&=\frac{x}{9}\\9\sin62^\circ&=x\\x&\approx7.95\end{align*}$$
